Door County Kayak Tours & Rentals

 Kayaking in Door County, Wisconsin

 When you go kayaking with a guided Door County Kayak Tour you will be able to relax and take in some of the most beautiful scenery in the Midwest. In this fast-paced world of work, traffic, kids and life we understand how important quality travel is these days. Besides the scenery, it is our guides who will make your Door County tour. Make a Door County Kayak Tours reservation for your second or third day in your trip to give you leeway for inclement door county weather. Download or have us send you a brochure.
